Blockchain technology works like a shared digital notebook that is copied across many computers, ensuring that no single person controls it. This setup makes transactions secure and transparent. Each page, or "block," holds a group of transactions. Once these are checked and added, they cannot be changed or erased. This is because each page is cryptographically locked to the one before it, creating a strong chain that is very hard to fake or tamper with.
